name: Onewire
summary: Radio + satellite broadband under Broadband Connect (Onewire, early 2000s); later rebranded Skyoptic; defunct (154 COLLINS STREET PTY LIMITED, ACN 103 233 567).

events.details: Rebranded Skyoptic; defunct. Site live Jul 2008, parked by Feb 2011 with a total 2009-10 capture void — dying in 2008-2011, safely recorded as 'by Feb 2011'; confirms the proposal over the current c. 2006.
